d:
A Thanksgiving goes awry.
A group of friends has gathered for their annual Friendsgiving dinner. The table is set, the food is cooking and they're all waiting for Will, who is always late. But the jovial atmosphere crumbles momentarily when they discover a zombie has bitten Will.
Everyone knows people have an hour before infection sets in and Will turns into a mindless zombie, and Will is determined to spend his last hour with his beloved friends. But plenty can go awry in an hour...
